d: Rodelinda's apartments. We see Rodelinda sitting weeping; and then Grimoaldo, and Garibaldo with Guards.
The wood of cypresses where the tombs of the king of the Longobards are seen, and among them recently erected the urn of Bertarido. Bertarido dressed in the Hungarian, and then Unulfo.
Rodelinda, holding Flavius' hand, and sayings aside.
Said, and Garibaldo with part of the Guards.
Bertarido and Unulfo, hidden; Garibaldo, Grimoaldo, and Guards.
Rodelinda and Flavio, Grimoaldo, Unulfo, Garibaldo and Guards.
Delightful place. Bertarido, then Eduige and then Unulfo.
Gallery in Rodelinda's apartment. Rodelinda and Unulfo.
Rodelinda, then Bertarido, and then Grimoaldo with Guards.
Dark prison, Bertarido, and then Unulfo.
Eduige, who drives by the hand Rodelinda and Flavio.
Grimaldo, Garibaldo, Bertarido, then Guards, and then Rodelinda with Flavio by the hand.
